column1: If using chicken breasts, pound them flat and slice into strips.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (204°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment or a silicone mat.
Pulse the corn flakes with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika in a food processor until coarsely crushed, then transfer to a bowl.
Set up two more bowls: one with the flour and one with the eggs whisked into the milk.
Dredge each strip in flour, dip in the egg mixture, then press into the corn flake coating. Arrange on the baking sheet.
Bake 10 minutes, flip, and bake about 10 minutes more until crisp and cooked through.
Let cool 5 minutes, then toss the chicken in a bowl with the buffalo sauce, adding more to taste.
For the dip, stir together the mayonnaise, sour cream, milk, Worcestershire, and blue cheese.
Serve warm with the blue cheese dip and celery sticks.
